description: TenantKeep Posture check catalog. One file per domain. Copyright (c) 2026 Kainor LLC; the catalog text, logic and framework mappings are the protected part of the product (LICENSE.md). domains: every domain in report order with its label; the report, the findings export and the public catalog page read it, so a new domain is data only. attack: the MITRE ATT&CK release the checks' technique ids are checked against; build.ps1 -Task AttackData writes checks/attack.json from that release and refuses any other. changes: one entry per catalog version whose checks changed meaning, with the checks that can move for a tenant that did not change and why; the trend reads it so a result that moved with the catalog is not called a new failure or a fix.

changes.summary: A check has no answer where its data is missing or was read in part, instead of a pass or a fail. Administrators are counted as people: a role held through a group, or as eligible, counts. Affected counts above 500 are the true number.

checks.ID-001: Counts the people who hold Global Administrator, the members of a group that holds it included; a group used to count as one.
checks.ID-002: Counts permanent roles held through a group.
checks.ID-003: Counts synced accounts that hold a role through a group.
checks.ID-004: Counts licensed accounts that hold a role through a group.
checks.AU-008: Holds administrators who are only eligible, or who hold a role through a group, to a phishing-resistant method.
checks.EM-025: Everyone who holds a role counts as an administrator, and the number listed is the true count.
